section.title: Backup & Restore
section.description: Save a copy of everything on this device, or restore from a backup file.

export.label: Export Backup
export.description: Save your profile, contacts, and destinations to a file you can share or store.
export.confirmMessage: The exported file will contain unencrypted medical information, including health conditions, medications, and emergency contacts. Only share it with people you trust.
export.success: Your backup was created. Choose where to save or send it.
export.unavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.
export.failure: Couldn't create the backup. Please try again.

import.label: Restore from Backup
import.description: Load a profile, contacts, and destinations from a backup file.
import.summaryWithName: This backup for {{name}} was exported on {{date}} and includes {{contactCount}} contact(s) and {{destinationCount}} destination(s).
import.summaryWithoutName: This backup was exported on {{date}} and includes {{contactCount}} contact(s) and {{destinationCount}} destination(s).
import.overwriteWarning: Restoring will replace all data currently on this device. This cannot be undone.
import.success: Your data has been restored from the backup.
import.failure: Couldn't restore the backup. Please try again.

errors.not_backup: That file isn't a Back to Safety backup.
errors.unsupported_format_version: This backup was created by a newer version of the app. Please update the app and try again.
errors.newer_schema: This backup was created by a newer version of the app. Please update the app and try again.
errors.corrupt: That backup file appears to be damaged or incomplete.
